'''Vernon''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[xenobiology]] and one of three leading [[rakghoul]] experts on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki Sazen]] for being unable to fix the [[Ultrawave Transmitter]].
